bullets.text: Star Wars Returns! - **Disney** revives the original 1977 theatrical cut for a limited release in 2027.
Festive iPad Trees - **Apple** showcases winning Christmas tree designs at **Battersea Power Station** until December 24.
iPhone 17 Pro's Camera Change - Night mode in Portrait mode is missing, raising eyebrows among users.
Spotify Wrapped Party! - **Spotify** introduces a new feature for group listening competitions in its annual recap.
Waymo's Software Recall - **Waymo** to address robotaxi behavior around school buses with a voluntary software recall.
eSIM Adoption Rising - Travel and device compatibility are driving increased adoption of **eSIM** technology.
ChatGPT Growth Slows - **ChatGPT** faces competition as its user growth begins to taper off amid rising interest in **Google's Gemini**.
Meta Acquires Limitless - **Meta** expands its AI capabilities with the acquisition of AI device startup **Limitless**.
Chamberlain's Smart Home Lockdown - New updates restrict third-party integrations for **Chamberlain** garage door openers.
SpaceX's Valuation Soars - **SpaceX** reportedly seeks a secondary sale at an $800 billion valuation, aiming for top private company status.
